purpose: Matched 47-versus-10 microfarad input-storage sensitivity on one explicitly assumed q-only conditional source model
claim_boundary: No native equivalence, PMIC, firmware, receiver, task/mission, robustness, physical safety, hardware feasibility or Agent efficacy claim
damping_provenance: Inherited uncalibrated development assumption from source world; c=2*zeta*sqrt(m*k), not inferred from ceramic Qm

rectifier.type: ideal full-wave bridge plus fixed series resistor and otherwise ideal storage capacitor
rectifier.choice: Explicit round-number passive benchmark assumption selected before trajectories, not measured ESR and not a fitted/optimized/native diode or PMIC model
rectifier.law: I=max(abs(Vp)-Vs,0)/R; terminal outward i=sign(Vp)*I; Qdot=-i; Cin*Vsdot=I
rectifier.power_identity: Vp*i = Vs*I + R*I^2 >=0 for Vs>=0; ideal diode loss=0

initial_recipe: Same retained stable closed-door root for all four trajectories, selected by STATIC-PREFLIGHT-PLAN; Q0=theta*q0 makes physical Vpiezo=0; signed electrode charge is not an electrical precharge
initial_preparation: Computational initial equilibrium only; initial elastic and signed mutual potential are accounted; preparation/reset work remains unknown and no first-operation/reset qualification is claimed
magnetic_potential_gauge: Mutual potential tends to zero at infinite separation; initial Umag is signed, and adding a constant does not change equations or ledger gates

driver_input.break_handling: two continuous-state integration segments meet exactly at 2s; one-sided driver powers retained

ledger.work_scope: Work by externally prescribed driver against magnetic forces and torque only; driver-mechanism inertia, actuation friction and reset are outside boundary
ledger.normalization: max(initial nonmagnetic positive storage,abs(Wdriver),abs(Umag(t)-Umag(0)),1e-9 J); invariant to magnetic additive constant

mechanical_assumptions: One retained Ritz bending coordinate with fixed mass/stiffness/reciprocal piezo port
Magnetic COM path and pitch are q-only short-circuit kinematics; nonzero-voltage axial shift beta*V and force-induced additional axial shift are omitted
Discarded bending shapes and torque-driven modal content, axial inertia, geometric/material nonlinearity, actual tensor, damping, losses, assembly and installation physics are unqualified
Voltage/domain guards are computational only. No negligibility or physical-accuracy bound on omitted coordinates is claimed
path_quadrature_check: Direct unchanged finite-cuboid evaluations at n=6 and n=10 at every accepted interval start, midpoint and end, separately from timestep refinement; raw Ftip, tip torque, driver COM torque, driver pose derivative and powers retained. Differences are empirical numerical refinement evidence, not rigorous error bounds or physical validation.
resolution_rationale: Mechanical period about 62.75ms; R*Cp about 1.875ms. Implicit Radau resolves passive-RC stiffness, adaptive tolerances treat diode corners; exact input break and fixed refinements declared before output. No PMIC source timestep imported.

gates.continuous_numerical_path: Radau cubic q extrema exactly evaluated. Magnet clearance at interval start minus h*(maximum tip translation/rotation speed + driver translation/rotation speed) must remain >1e-12m. This bounds separation along numerical cubic, not exact ODE path or surrounding assembly.

stop_conditions: nonfinite/negative passive store/domain/contact or continuous clearance guard
unresolved force quadrature or energy accounting
after one trajectory failure stop branch; no replacement, retry, threshold tuning or new design
after time-refinement failure retain four results but no admitted sensitivity conclusion
outputs: raw state samples on common 1ms grid
all accepted states and every Radau cubic coefficient
raw n6/n10 potentials and primitive force/torque/driver-pose derivatives at all accepted endpoints/midpoints
sample powers and ODE-integrated signed translational/rotational driver work
independent Simpson integration of all four work/loss rates
domain checks with cubic extrema and magnet-clearance bounds
peak/final q, piezo and storage voltages/energy, budgets, failures, source and code hashes
interpretation_rule: Report signed cin10-minus-cin47 differences in final storage energy and peak storage voltage, plus coupled q/piezo/energy partition. Compare each effect against five times sum of observed within-case coarse/fine deltas; below this report numerically unresolved. This is not a confidence/error bound or guarantee against common-mode quadrature/model errors.
authorization_status: No trajectories; pending independently reviewed repair seal and exact new root authorization

jacobian.method: analytic branch-aware circuit and exact zero-ledger columns; bounded magnetic q-only differences
jacobian.kink_convention: inactive branch at abs(Vp)==Vs; current law unchanged
